content:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick update  we closed a 2.5yr Dedicated + ISV listing with Verdant Health on GCP Marketplace. They've also requested Redwood Private (VPC) for PHI workloads. Launch comms planned for Wed morning. :tada:
Connor (Sales): Awesome! Can we get a short customer quote and a logo? I asked for a procurement contact.
Priya (Marketing): I'll own the case study + blog. Need: 1 sentence quote (<= 120 chars), 2-sentence customer profile, and logo by EOD tomorrow to hit Wed. Can we get a short CTO soundbite?
Ibrahim (Solutions): Tech setup: dedicated GPU cluster in gcp-europe-west1 provisioned, model pinned to `rwd-mosaic-8b-q4`, canary routing at 5%, KV cache priming scheduled. We'll enable audit logs to their KMS and set p95 alert at 200ms.
Leah (Finance): Contract countersigned  committed ARR $920k, 2.5 years. PO ETA next week. Billing contact: finance@verdanthealth.io. Include advanced SLAs per SOW.
Maya (Partnerships): Verdant legal approved this short quote: "Redwood gave us predictable, private inference for patient-facing features." They're sending brand kit + quote by 2pm.
PubBot: GCP Marketplace listing published: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/details/verdant-health/redwood (listing id: gcp-0xC9D). Propagation ~20-60 mins.
Connor (Sales): Great. Are we allowed to co-brand social?
Maya (Partnerships): Yes, they approved co-branded posts and a joint webinar in 4 weeks.
Priya (Marketing): Draft announcement uploaded: https://redwood.workplace/drafts/verdant-health-launch.md. I'll schedule social Wed 9am CET. Will request a 45s CTO clip.
Ibrahim (Solutions): Launch checklist: 1) KV warm 2) perf smoke tests (Ibrahim) 3) canary -> 25% after 30m -> 100% 4) enable audit/KMS 5) share perf dashboard link here after smoke.
Leah (Finance): Note: revenue recognition will be per contract schedule; tagging finance on any SOW changes.
Maya (Partnerships): Assigning owners: @Priya - publish comms; @Ibrahim - perf + CTO clip coordination; @Leah - confirm PO + billing. Thanks team! :rocket:
Priya (Marketing): Quick shoutout to @Maya and @Ibrahim for fast turnaround. Will post finalized launch note once marketplace indexing completes.
